paragraphs.text: Phoebe is a legendary human spy from Bablovia in the Un-iverse .

Phoebe was introduced as a character in Unstable as the self-proclaimed head of the Agents of S.N.E.A.K. . Whoever possesses the Golden Ruler becomes the official leader of the organization. This has led to many government turnovers, although most were the same three people. Most leadership changes are attributed to a shadowy figure known only as X who is constantly paid by different sources to steal the Golden Ruler. She is a light skinned female human with dark hair. She has control of various mechanical arms, contraptions , and smoky tendrils to assist with her clandestine activities.
